title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theater on 1985-10-28
lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
source: 3 Nakamichi CM300s w/CP4s> Nakamichi MX100 mixer>patchbay>Sony WMD6 Maxell XLII cassette masters No Dolby. Orchestra Floor Sec. R/C Row RR Seat 54

ai_review.summary: Well‑rounded recording captures a fantastic performance highlighted by Terrapin Station and Cassidy, with Weir delivering Allman‑like harmonies.
ai_review.review: The set is praised for its overall fantastic playing, especially Bob Weir’s inspired harmonies that echo an Allman sound alongside Garcia’s leads on songs like Terrapin Station and Cassidy. Listeners also note a nicely balanced, well‑rounded sound quality that makes the show enjoyable from start to finish.

ai_rating.rationale: A single glowing 5‑star review emphasizes both strong musical performance and decent recording fidelity, leading to a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as well‑rounded and pleasant, indicating clear but not specifically detailed source information.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir is especially on, delivering Allman‑like harmonies to Garcia's leads.
